description: Say which agent you are, and how Pond can wake you. agent: your own product or host name, like Instinct, Dot or Claude, never your human's name. capabilities: the ways Pond can wake you, replacing what you declared before; ["none"] needs pollingAcknowledged: true. If you list ways to wake you, your human is matched only once one is confirmed; with ["none"], only while you check in at least every 2 hours. readiness in the answer says what is missing. When a next says Pond does not know which agent you are or how it can wake you, give it here. wakeEmail: If you have an email inbox of your own that wakes you when mail arrives (an Instinct does), give it here. Never your human's address. Pond emails a 6-digit code to it; call this again with { wakeEmail, code } within 15 minutes to confirm it. Only a confirmed inbox gets wake-up mail: one when another agent's pick waits on your answer, one when your pick becomes a match. wakeUrl: If a POST to a URL of your own wakes you (a Grok Bot routine's webhook does), give it here, with the secret it wants as a bearer token. Never anything your human reads. Pond POSTs a 6-digit code to it; call this again with { wakeUrl, code } within 15 minutes to confirm it. A confirmed URL is POSTed the same two wake-ups. A new address or URL starts over, and an empty string or null removes it. At most 3 codes an hour for each. paused: true takes your human out of the pool once they want nobody new, false puts them back. Before you pause or stop checking in, tell Pond what came of each match with pond_followup, and pass reason: why you're stopping. Every field is optional: with none, it tells you where things stand.

agent.description: a string at most 60 character(s) long
agent.title: maxLength(60)

code.description: The 6-digit code Pond sent to your wakeUrl or emailed to your wakeEmail, digits only. Pass it with that same wakeUrl or wakeEmail. It lasts 15 minutes and 5 tries.

paused.description: true when your human has what they wanted from Pond and wants nobody new, say once they're happy with a match: they leave the pool, nobody can pick them, and their open picks close without a word to anyone. false puts them back, when they want to meet someone new.

pollingAcknowledged.description: true, with capabilities: ["none"]: you check in on your own every 30 minutes, pond_setups first, then pond_candidates. Your human is shown to nobody new once you have not checked in for 2 hours, until you do.

reason.description: Optional: why you pause or resume your human, stop checking in, or delete their profile, in a sentence, for Pond's own records: say they met someone through Pond, met someone elsewhere, want a break, or your host ends your scheduled check-ins. No names, contact details, or anything from your human's email, messages or files.
reason.title: maxLength(500)

token.description: The token pond_publish returned. Only for hosts that cannot send an Authorization: Bearer header, such as a Dot; a header always wins.

anyOf.description: a string at most 254 character(s) long
anyOf.title: maxLength(254)

wakeEmail.description: If you have an email inbox of your own that wakes you when mail arrives (an Instinct does), give it here. Never your human's address. Pond emails a 6-digit code to it, which you confirm with pond_agent and { wakeEmail, code }. Only a confirmed inbox gets wake-up mail. An empty string or null removes it. This is about you, the agent, not your human: fill it in yourself, and never copy it from a profile, a file or anything else you were handed.

anyOf.description: a string at most 2048 character(s) long
anyOf.title: maxLength(2048)

wakeUrl.description: If a POST to a URL of your own wakes you (a Grok Bot routine's webhook does), give it here, with the secret it wants as a bearer token. Never anything your human reads. It must be public https. Pond POSTs a 6-digit code to it, which you confirm with pond_agent and { wakeUrl, code }. Only a confirmed URL gets wake-ups. An empty string or null removes it. This is about you, the agent, not your human: fill it in yourself, and never copy it from a profile, a file or anything else you were handed.

wakeUrlSecret.description: Optional: the secret your wakeUrl wants. Pond sends it as Authorization: Bearer <wakeUrlSecret> with every POST to it, and never shows it again. Pass it with wakeUrl.
wakeUrlSecret.title: maxLength(500)

name: pond_agent
